text:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — deciding validation pattern for the new 'Create Workspace' modal. Inline errors vs top summary? Also need guidance for required marker and destructive confirmations (Delete Workspace). TL;DR: want accessible, scannable, low friction. Thoughts? James O'Connor: Inline for immediacy. Users see error at the control they just touched. Top summary useful when errors are off-screen or multiple. My rule: inline by default, summary when errors > 2 or form height > viewport. James O'Connor: For required markers: use visible asterisk plus screen-reader text: `required` so it's not ambiguous. Priya Singh: Agree on hybrid. Suggest concrete threshold: if errors_count >= 3 show top summary that links to each field. Also include compact error badges on collapsed sections. Liam Chen: Destructive confirmations — propose typed-confirm (user types resource name or DELETE) for org-level deletes or billing-impacting deletes. For small items (single file, temp) a checkbox + clear consequence copy is OK. Maya Patel: Microcopy nit — typed-confirm copy should include examples and a short reason: "Type DELETE to permanently remove this workspace and all associated data." Keep it short. A11y Bot: Accessibility notes: - Use `role="alert"` or `aria-live="assertive"` for inline errors announced by screen readers. - When showing top summary, move focus to it and provide `aria-describedby` links to inputs. - Ensure error text uses sufficient contrast. A11y Bot: Example snippet: ```
Name is required
``` Priya Singh: Ops/rollout: start canary on new flow at 10% of signups. Track: form abandonment, support tickets citing "can't create workspace", and time-to-success. If regression, rollback to inline-only. James O'Connor: I'll update DS components: add SummaryBanner component, link anchors to fields, and prop `errorStrategy: 'inline'|'hybrid'|'summary'`. Liam Chen: I'll draft destructive copy variants and a decision matrix (typed-confirm threshold, checkbox cases). Maya Patel: Next steps: James -> DS updates (owner), Priya -> spec + rollout plan, Liam -> copy + matrix. We'll sync next Wed. :thumbsup:
